args.name: block
args.description: The block at which the query should be executed. Can either be a `{ hash: Bytes }` value containing a block hash, a `{ number: Int }` containing the block number, or a `{ number_gte: Int }` containing the minimum block number. In the case of `number_gte`, the query will be executed on the latest block only if the subgraph has progressed to or past the minimum block number. Defaults to the latest block when omitted.

fields.name: _logs
fields.description: Query execution logs emitted by the subgraph during indexing. Results are sorted by timestamp in descending order (newest first).

args.name: level
args.description: Filter logs by severity level. Only logs at this level will be returned.

args.name: from
args.description: Filter logs from this timestamp onwards (inclusive). Must be in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z').

args.name: to
args.description: Filter logs until this timestamp (inclusive). Must be in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T23:59:59Z').

args.name: search
args.description: Search for logs containing this text in the message. Case-insensitive substring match. Maximum length: 1000 characters.

args.name: first
args.description: Maximum number of logs to return. Default: 100, Maximum: 1000.

args.name: skip
args.description: Number of logs to skip (for pagination). Default: 0, Maximum: 10000.

args.name: orderDirection
args.description: Sort direction for results. Default: desc (newest first).

types.name: _LogArgument_
types.description:
A key-value pair of additional data associated with a log entry.
These correspond to arguments passed to the log function in the subgraph code.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The parameter value, serialized as a string

types.name: _LogMeta_
types.description:
Source code location metadata for a log entry.
Indicates where in the subgraph's AssemblyScript code the log statement was executed.

fields.name: module
fields.description: The module or file path where the log was emitted

fields.name: line
fields.description: The line number in the source file

fields.name: column
fields.description: The column number in the source file

types.name: _Log_
types.description:
A log entry emitted by a subgraph during indexing.
Logs can be generated by the subgraph's AssemblyScript code using the `log.*` functions.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this log entry

fields.name: subgraphId
fields.description: The deployment hash of the subgraph that emitted this log

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: The timestamp when the log was emitted, in RFC3339 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z')

fields.name: level
fields.description: The severity level of the log entry

fields.name: arguments
fields.description: Additional structured data passed to the log function as key-value pairs

fields.name: meta
fields.description: Metadata about the source location in the subgraph code where the log was emitted

types.name: _Meta_
types.description: The type for the top-level _meta field

fields.name: block
fields.description:
Information about a specific subgraph block. The hash of the block
will be null if the _meta field has a block constraint that asks for
a block number. It will be filled if the _meta field has no block constraint
and therefore asks for the latest  block

fields.name: hasIndexingErrors
fields.description: If `true`, the subgraph encountered indexing errors at some past block

enumValues.name: allow
enumValues.description: Data will be returned even if the subgraph has indexing errors

enumValues.name: deny
enumValues.description: If the subgraph has indexing errors, data will be omitted. The default.
